title: Graphic Design editorial consolidation audit
scope: Historical editorial audit of58 candidates before implementation. The consolidation record describes current authored content; baseline hashes below intentionally describe the pre-consolidation source.

questions: Can the reader make one distinct design decision?
Is there an observable failure rather than a preferred style?
Can the repair be distinguished from neighboring repairs?
Does the material earn a separate article rather than a technique, diagnostic or foundation?
method.review_depth: Reviewed all52 authored openings/core interventions and worked-example structures, relevant specific-change passages, package descriptions and mechanisms, and additional overlap passages. This is an editorial structure/intervention review, not a line-by-line copy edit, source revalidation or renewed visual QA. Six unexpanded candidates are provisional title-level judgments.
method.rule: Passing the first three questions does not automatically justify a full article. Keep an independently diagnosable intervention; nest a method that mainly executes another decision. Do not merge merely because two variables interact or share an aesthetic goal.
method.numerical_target: No quota used. The39-core result follows the individual judgments; it is not evidence that39 is an objectively optimal count.

editorial_contract.reader_problem: Crossing connectors invite the wrong pairing or a path misaligns across a gap.

editorial_contract.intervention: Make the intended object or layer distinguishable from its ground.

editorial_contract.reader_problem: A complete motif obscures an object, or excessive omission destroys a recognizable whole.
editorial_contract.intervention: Choose which contour evidence may remain incomplete.

editorial_contract.reader_problem: A display cut weakens prose or reference characters are easily confused.
editorial_contract.intervention: Choose letterforms suited to task, voice, characters and medium.

editorial_contract.reader_problem: Equivalent titles and metadata accumulate arbitrary size differences.
editorial_contract.intervention: Build a reusable size vocabulary for recurring text roles.

editorial_contract.reader_problem: Lines are too long to return across comfortably or too narrow to retain phrases.
editorial_contract.intervention: Set the horizontal measure of prose.

editorial_contract.reader_problem: Dense lines interfere or overly loose lines fragment a paragraph.
editorial_contract.intervention: Set baseline intervals for connected text.

editorial_contract.reader_problem: Quotation marks create an apparent indent or punctuation pulls apparent centering.
editorial_contract.intervention: Correct perceived edges or centers when geometry is misleading.

editorial_contract.reader_problem: A headline inherits loose tracking or one pair creates a conspicuous gap.
editorial_contract.intervention: Repair intervals within a text run or a particular pair.

editorial_contract.reader_problem: A value separates from its unit or a headline breaks at an awkward phrase boundary.
editorial_contract.intervention: Place line boundaries to support phrasing and meaningful expressions.

editorial_contract.reader_problem: A visual idea replaces a necessary letter or an expressive brief remains a plain label.
editorial_contract.intervention: Give letterforms a relevant visual job while preserving reading.

editorial_contract.reader_problem: Arbitrary hues suggest categories that the content does not contain.
editorial_contract.intervention: Choose which colors earn places in the working set.

editorial_contract.reader_problem: Text, an empty checkbox or a priority field has the wrong tonal relationship.
editorial_contract.intervention: Set useful light–dark separation.

editorial_contract.reader_problem: A reader cannot map a color-coded status or chart series to its meaning.
editorial_contract.intervention: Make identifying hue unnecessary for necessary meaning.

editorial_contract.reader_problem: A finished product illustrates a making class without showing the activity.
editorial_contract.intervention: Choose which image contributes the needed information or association.

editorial_contract.reader_problem: A handle is cut off or context needed to judge a room is excluded.
editorial_contract.intervention: Choose the visible window within an existing image.

editorial_contract.reader_problem: An offer sits away from its photograph or labels cannot identify exact features.
editorial_contract.intervention: Coordinate what words and pictures contribute and refer to.

editorial_contract.reader_problem: Incidental surface or atmosphere obscures a category, arrangement or task model.
editorial_contract.intervention: Choose which features and relationships a representation must preserve.

editorial_contract.reader_problem: A comparison lacks a target or imports implications that conflict with the brief.
editorial_contract.intervention: Borrow a relationship from one subject to communicate another.

editorial_contract.reader_problem: A familiar object leaves the service unclear or an upload icon contradicts Download.
editorial_contract.intervention: Choose an established cue that matches the service or action.

editorial_contract.reader_problem: Related artifacts use incompatible role assignments or appear unrelated.
editorial_contract.intervention: Define stable cross-artifact visual roles and permitted variation.

editorial_contract.reader_problem: An internally consistent identity remains confusable with another organization.
editorial_contract.intervention: Help people distinguish this identity from plausible alternatives.

editorial_contract.reader_problem: Recurring documents need repeated manual assembly or omit required content.
editorial_contract.intervention: Make repeated production reliable without rebuilding each artifact.
